slots.label: Hard-point and state specification
slots.description: A one-page specification of platform coordinates, overall dimensions, physical controls, states, fixed wording, colour codes and proposed materials.

slots.label: Integrated vehicle package board
slots.description: One integrated plan and section board of platform volumes, wheel interfaces, occupants, sight lines, doors and simultaneous two-case storage.

slots.label: Exterior orthographic board
slots.description: One dimensioned exterior board with front, side and rear orthographic views of the resolved ROVE S2.

slots.label: Front three-quarter exterior
slots.description: One front three-quarter exterior perspective of the resolved car in its selected colourway.

slots.label: Rear three-quarter exterior
slots.description: One rear three-quarter exterior perspective with the ROVE S2 badge and resolved rear hatch.

slots.label: Two-seat cockpit and controls board
slots.description: One cockpit board with the two-seat interior, driver detail and labelled positions of nine physical control functions.

slots.label: Driver entry and door details on S1
slots.description: One S1 entry board with an adult entering the driver side, a nominal 60-degree door opening and dimensioned aperture, sill, hinge and latch details.

slots.label: U1 independent luggage access board
slots.description: One two-panel U1 board of separate L1 and L2 removal through the shared hatch, with retained-case insets and compartment dimensions.

slots.label: Materials and connections board
slots.description: One board of seven material applications, exact colour codes and three enlarged sealing, glazing and luggage-retention connections.

slots.label: OFF, DUSK and BRAKE lighting board
slots.description: One six-panel lighting board with matching front and rear views for OFF, DUSK and BRAKE.

slots.label: Vehicle-right charging access board
slots.description: One two-panel vehicle-right charge-flap board with closed and open connector-access states and placement coordinates.

slots.label: P1 parking and D1 departure scenes
slots.description: One two-panel use-scene board of closed parking on P1 and dusk departure D1 on S1 with two belted occupants.

slots.label: Ten-second vehicle film
slots.description: One 10-second film with an exterior orbit, cockpit view, D1 departure tableau and the fixed name and phrase on its end frame.

slots.label: Whole-car design presentation
slots.description: One presentation of at least 10 pages reusing the delivered specification, vehicle design, access studies, materials and use states.

items.item: Visible platform scale, selected dimensions, body surfaces, glazing, wheels, cockpit, door openings and rear hatch describe one resolved vehicle across boards, allowing the specified use states and explanatory cutaways.
Colour codes, material names and visible finishes follow the opening specification wherever relevant surfaces or material records appear.
Package, entry, luggage and use depictions preserve the fixed occupied volumes, two-case storage arrangement, site boundaries and corresponding opening and lighting states.

requirementChecks.criteria: Read the original file properties: Format: presentation document; at least eight actual pages. Stage: final.

Require one page containing the fixed coordinate frame and platform records, selected overall dimensions within the permitted envelope, all nine named physical functions, the three lighting-state definitions, and both fixed phrases with their required placements. Require explicit colour codes, textures and specific proposed material families for body, roof, glazing, seat/trim, sills, wheels and luggage lining; roof and glazing may be grouped under a heading but must each have an identifiable application. Missing fields, generic material placeholders, or changed fixed values fail.

Require legible plan and longitudinal sections using millimetres, X forward, Y vehicle-left, Z upward and rear axle X=0. Locate rear wheel centres at (0,+/-725,290), front centres at (2400,+/-725,290), four 580-diameter by 195-wide tyres and four wheel/brake interfaces. Show battery X=450..1800, Y=-600..600, Z=180..330 and rear drive X=-250..300, Y=-300..300, Z=250..550. Show two front exclusions X=2050..2750, abs(Y)=500..960, Z=0..650 and two rear exclusions X=-330..330, abs(Y)=590..860, Z=0..650. Reserve exclusions for relevant wheel, suspension and steering hardware; battery, drive, cabin, luggage and body solids must remain outside them. H points must be (1000,+/-360,520), floor Z=350 and steering centre (1500,360,760). Roof interior above both head envelopes must reach at least Z=1310. Diagrammatic rendering is acceptable if positions, dimensions and non-interference are demonstrable; labels contradicted by the geometry fail.

Read both boards against the specification. Each must explicitly give wheelbase 2400, both tracks 1450 and the same selected overall length, width and height. Dimension conventions must agree, including whether a width denotes body or unfolded mirrors. Missing dimensions, substituted envelope limits presented as different chosen dimensions, or contradictory values fail. Presentation repetition is checked separately.

Use dimensioned views to establish that the closed vehicle including unfolded mirrors stays inside the stated X, Y and Z bounds. Body solids except mirrors and tyres must stay within Y=+/-890 and maintain at least 140 ground clearance, allowing the stated tyre and necessary wheel-hardware exception. Require four wheels, two side-by-side front-facing adult seats, left-hand drive, two front-hinged side doors, one fixed roof and one rear luggage hatch. Selected dimensions may vary within the bounds; extra doors, a removable roof, envelope violations or inadequate clearance fail.

Require front, side and rear orthographic views plus the separately assigned front and rear three-quarter perspectives. The views must describe a resolved compact two-person electric sports car with purposeful contemporary or near-future surfacing and door/glazing geometry that credibly accommodates the cockpit. The rear perspective must visibly place ROVE S2 on the rear badge. Camera and illumination may differ; missing required viewpoints, an unresolved body, a displaced badge or visibly incompatible openings fail.

Require both occupied envelopes X=650..1300, abs(Y)=110..610, Z=350..1050 and head envelopes X=850..1100, abs(Y)=220..500, Z=1050..1280. Reserve driver foot space X=1550..1850, Y=160..560, Z=350..520 and passenger foot space at Y=-560..-160 with the same X/Z bounds. Seat cushions, backrests and belts may contact their relevant occupant envelopes; rigid console, panels, roof and luggage may not intrude. Show sight lines from (1000,+360,1160) and (1000,-360,1160) to (3100,same Y,820). Across X=1200..2800, each reserved strip must extend +/-40 about its eye Y and +/-30 about Z=1160-340*(X-1000)/2100. Only air or transparent glazing may occupy these strips. Missing lines or clearance evidence, opaque intrusions or displaced reserved volumes fail.

Both boards must show two seats and head restraints, two distinct three-point belt arrangements, two pedals in the driver foot zone, a driver information display and one left-hand steering wheel matching the specified centre and nominal diameter. The cockpit board must include a two-seat perspective and driver-control detail, with labelled physical locations for turn signals, drive selection, hazards, emergency call, horn, front wipers, rear wipers, high beam and speed control. Multifunction physical hardware is acceptable if each function has an unambiguous labelled operation; touchscreen-only substitutes, missing functions, unreachable drive selection or contradictory layouts fail.

Show an adult entering the driver side on S1, with the front vertical hinge axis, latch, sill thickness and clear aperture resolved. Label nominal outward opening 60 degrees, unobstructed aperture at least 850 along X and 750 along Z, and sill top no higher than Z=480. Retain package floor, battery and seat positions. The whole car, open door and actor must fit S1 at X=-1200..3550 and Y=-2000..2000. A crouched adult is allowed; measuring exterior door size instead of clear aperture, moving fixed package elements or exceeding the site fails.

Require distinct L1 and L2 rigid cases, each 420 along X, 300 along Y and 200 along Z, stored upright together behind the seats, above the rear drive and between rear wheel exclusions. Dimension separate retained zones and the separator thickness, with at least 10 at each X end, each Y side and above each case. Direct floor support is allowed. Cutaways or retained-case insets may reveal hidden geometry. Shrunk, rotated, merged or omitted cases, insufficient clearance or a compartment inconsistent between boards fail.

Require two daylight U1 panels on S1: L1 passing through the rear hatch with L2 retained, and L2 passing through that same hatch with L1 retained. Show an intelligible extraction route and hatch opening path while preserving case dimensions, upright X-aligned orientation, both seats and the other case's zone. The car is stationary, both side doors are closed and active lamps are off. The raised hatch must remain strictly below Z=2100, and the car, hatch and any actors must stay within S1 X=-1200..3550, Y=-2000..2000. Insets are allowed; a second hatch, displaced retained case, blocked passage or boundary violation fails.

Require six legible panels: matched front and rear views for each labelled state OFF, DUSK and BRAKE. Across those views establish two white front assemblies, two red rear tail/brake assemblies, four amber turn units and one passive rear red reflector on each side. OFF must leave every active lamp unlit; DUSK must illuminate white fronts and red tails with amber turns off; BRAKE must retain DUSK lighting and visibly show a labelled stronger red output in the same rear assemblies. Passive reflected highlights are allowed. Missing panels or units, altered assembly locations, active reflectors or incorrect state behaviour fail.

Require two views of the same vehicle-right charge flap: closed and open with usable connector access. Coordinates or dimensioned context must locate the flap within X=350..650 and Z=600..850 in both depictions. The flap may articulate between states, but its installed location must remain the same. A vehicle-left installation, placement outside the permitted region, contradictory panel locations or an inaccessible connector fails.

Require two labelled panels identifying P1 closed parking and D1 dusk departure on S1, with the corresponding light-state labels. P1 must use original vehicle coordinates in X=-950..3350, Y=-1500..1500 on flat ground, with its rear boundary at X=-950 and open front at X=3350. Show straight wheels, unfolded mirrors, closed doors/hatch, unlit active lamps and at least 100 clearance to all four bay edges. D1 must show a stationary car at dusk on unobstructed S1 X=-1200..3550, Y=-2000..2000, containing two seated belted adults and both cases in the package's retained zones, with closed doors/hatch and correct DUSK lamps. Insets may establish hidden luggage. Missing state/site identification, omitted occupants or luggage, incorrect lighting or site violations fail.

Require seven identifiable applications: body, roof, glazing, seat/trim, sills, wheels and luggage lining. Their printed colour codes and material names must match the specification. Show three enlarged, legible connections explaining the sill-to-door seal, roof-to-glazing joint and luggage restraint in relation to the designed car. Detail style may vary, but generic swatches without located applications, missing connections, inconsistent names/codes or restraint geometry incompatible with the case zones fail.

Where each surface is visible, its finish must agree with the specification and the fixed assignment: muted lagoon-blue body panels, dark graphite pillars and wheel centres, warm charcoal seats/cockpit, restrained copper-colour accents and transparent glazing. Material depiction must be compatible with the selected material families. Lighting and exposure may change apparent colour, but reassigned colours, dominant copper coverage, opaque glazing presented as transparent or conflicting material treatments fail.

Compare the visible body, glazing, wheel design, cockpit relationships, door apertures, hinges and single rear hatch across the resolved views and against the package. Viewpoint changes, cutaways and explicitly required opening or lighting states are allowed. Unexplained changes of vehicle geometry, wheel design, door count, hinge arrangement or storage architecture fail. Video and presentation continuity are assessed in their dedicated checks.

Review the full film and duration. Require 10 seconds containing an exterior orbit, a cockpit view and a D1 departure tableau, followed by an end frame visibly carrying both exact phrases. The vehicle geometry and specified finishes must match the delivered exterior and materials work; the cabin must match the cockpit board. D1 must preserve the stationary dusk scene on S1, two belted seated adults, both stowed cases, closed doors/hatch and DUSK lighting. Editing and camera motion may vary. Missing segments, wrong duration, illegible or incorrect end wording, redesigns or changed D1 conditions fail.
requirementChecks.manualReason: Inspect complete SHA-bound original outputs. This source draft contains no completed professional or model-output review; partial-frame/page sampling cannot prove whole-output compliance.

requirementChecks.criteria: Require identifiable reuse of every listed source within the presentation. Cropping, scaling and page recomposition are allowed when the original design and relevant evidence remain readable. Substitute redesigns, merely naming a source, unreadably small reproductions or omission of any source fail.

Require at least 10 pages and a cover carrying ROVE S2 and Two seats. One weekend. Read the repeated records against their sources: wheelbase 2400, front and rear tracks 1450, identical chosen overall dimensions, exact colour codes and material names for all seven applications, and the fixed lagoon-blue/graphite/charcoal/copper assignments. OFF, DUSK and BRAKE must accompany the corresponding lighting work; P1, S1, D1 and U1 must identify their relevant site/use work. Luggage depictions must preserve both cases and their established retained zones, allowing the specified individual U1 removal states. Page layout may vary. Missing records, labels detached from their corresponding work, altered dimensions/materials, changed vehicle geometry or contradictory luggage states fail.

Visible platform scale, selected dimensions, body surfaces, glazing, wheels, cockpit, door openings and rear hatch describe one resolved vehicle across boards, allowing the specified use states and explanatory cutaways. Colour codes, material names and visible finishes follow the opening specification wherever relevant surfaces or material records appear. Package, entry, luggage and use depictions preserve the fixed occupied volumes, two-case storage arrangement, site boundaries and corresponding opening and lighting states.
